why.org_a:finding:05873: Critical KEV vulnerability on an internet-accessible asset that is part of the attack chain to the crown jewels.

reasoning: We identified findings on internet-facing hosts with high risk scores and KEV status that provide paths towards the crown-jewel data store. Fixing these critical vulnerabilities eliminates the primary externally reachable vectors.

input.sql:
SELECT 
  f.id AS finding_id,
  ast.id AS asset_id,
  ast.hostname,
  v.cve,
  v.cvss,
  v.kev
FROM edges e_exp
JOIN assets internet_ast ON e_exp.dst = internet_ast.id
JOIN zones z ON internet_ast.zone = z.id AND z.trust = 0
JOIN edges e_reach ON e_reach.src = internet_ast.id
JOIN assets ast ON e_reach.dst = ast.id
JOIN edges r_runs ON r_runs.src = ast.id
JOIN software sw ON r_runs.dst = sw.id
JOIN edges r_vuln ON r_vuln.src = sw.id
JOIN vuln v ON r_vuln.dst = v.id
JOIN findings f ON f.id = v.id -- wait, findings ON finding -> asset or finding -> vuln?
-- Let's check finding schema: ON finding -> asset; OF finding -> vuln

SELECT 
  f.id AS finding_id,
  ast.id AS asset_id,
  ast.hostname,
  v.cve,
  v.cvss,
  v.kev,
  ds.id AS datastore_id
FROM edges e_exp
JOIN assets internet_ast ON e_exp.dst = internet_ast.id
JOIN zones z ON internet_ast.zone = z.id AND z.trust = 0
JOIN edges e_reach ON e_reach.src = internet_ast.id
JOIN assets ast ON e_reach.dst = ast.id
JOIN edges r_runs ON r_runs.src = ast.id
JOIN software sw ON r_runs.dst = sw.id
JOIN edges r_vuln ON r_vuln.src = sw.id
JOIN vulns v ON r_vuln.dst = v.id
JOIN findings f ON f.dst = v.id -- wait, finding relationships: ON finding -> asset, OF finding -> vuln
JOIN edges f_on ON f_on.src = f.id AND f_on.dst = ast.id
JOIN edges f_of ON f_of.src = f.id AND f_of.dst = v.id
JOIN edges can_datastore ON can_datastore.src = ast.id -- or asset can reach datastore
JOIN datastores ds ON can_datastore.dst = ds.id AND ds.id = 'org_a:ds:00001'
WHERE f.status = 'open'
LIMIT 20;

input.sql:
SELECT 
  f.id AS finding_id,
  ast.hostname,
  v.cve,
  v.cvss,
  v.kev
FROM edges exp
JOIN zones z ON z.name = 'internet' -- or trust = 0
JOIN assets internet_ast ON exp.dst = internet_ast.id
JOIN edges reach ON reach.src = internet_ast.id
JOIN assets ast ON reach.dst = ast.id
JOIN edges runs ON runs.src = ast.id
JOIN software sw ON runs.dst = sw.id
JOIN edges has_vuln ON has_vuln.src = sw.id
JOIN vulns v ON has_vuln.dst = v.id
JOIN edges of_edge ON of_edge.dst = v.id
JOIN findings f ON of_edge.src = f.id
JOIN edges on_edge ON on_edge.src = f.id AND on_edge.dst = ast.id
WHERE f.status = 'open'
LIMIT 25;

SELECT e.type, a1.hostname as src_host, a2.hostname as dst_net, ds.id as ds_id
FROM edges e
JOIN assets a1 ON e.src = a1.id
LEFT JOIN assets a2 ON e.dst = a2.id
LEFT JOIN datastores ds ON e.dst = ds.id
WHERE ds.id = 'org_a:ds:00001' OR a1.cloud IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 20;

SELECT e.type, a.id, a.hostname, ds.id as ds_id
FROM edges e
JOIN assets a ON e.src = a.id
JOIN datastores ds ON e.dst = ds.id
WHERE ds.id = 'org_a:ds:00001';
